RE-GATE 3 (final) — EQUIVALENCE GREEN. HEAD dcd1d39 at gate time; review fixes merged after as 72a998e (post-render.py byte-identical, no DOM impact). B3/C3/D3 vs fresh A3 baseline, GITHUB_TOKEN exported (killed the rate-limit noise class from re-gate 2): 395/395 HTML pages byte-identical after canonicalization (cell ids, exec counts, tmp paths) in ALL three arms; 0 region-presence mismatches; search.json objectID sets equal; sitemap/llms.txt/robots equal. Sole residual: llms-full.txt, 4 lines of `<function ... at 0x...>` memory-address repr in signature defaults — run-varying between any two builds, benign.

Timings (CONTENDED machine — watchman sync timeouts, concurrent cargo builds from foreign WIP; source-links canary 7m20–8m52 vs clean-band 3m30–4m20, so ~1.6x inflation): A3 wall 989.6s / internal 505.1s (render 8m00) · B3 819.3 / 237.2 (4m06) · C3 1069.4 / 521.9 (8m14) · D3 790.5 / 256.9 (4m01). Clean-machine reference (gate 1, same day, flags-off + fast_sidebar): A 606.6 / 318.4 (5m07) · B 451.0 / 176.0 (2m56). Read: fast_sidebar −53% internal under identical load; parallel_render alone ≈ nil on this corpus (flat reference/ = one dir-shard; Quarto 1.9.38 `render` takes ONE input positional — extra args go to pandoc, exit 1; empirically proven this round, so dir granularity is the structural floor); combined ≈ fast_sidebar alone. <300s internal target met in both B arms (176 clean / 237 contended) and D3 (257 contended).

Fix round 2: dcd1d39 fixed the 4 residual title/breadcrumb classes (d-none d-lg-block now keyed on secnav_mode, CLI breadcrumb text sourced like stock's process_cli_reference_pages fallback, title-block-header insertion for direct-child CLI section pages). Adversarial review of 7bc26ee..dcd1d39 (3 lens finders → 14 findings → dual refuters killed 11 → 3 accepted; ran on opus xhigh, codex lane rate-limited until Jul 19): fixed as 86eba95 (_assert_complete accepts output-file relocation), 0d18d57 (malformed prior build-timings treated as absent + stash gated on parallel_render), 72a998e (firing tests for the 2 driver-block SystemExit guards). Touched suites 203 passed.

Gate-3 exclusions grew 21→28 (7 cc_transcript.tools exports) — concurrent cc-transcript WIP in the shared working copy (also broke bare `uv sync` on 74 gen_stub Rust errors and pruned the venv, restored via `uv pip install -e ~/Code/great-docs`); identical set across all four arms, not flag-attributable. Corpus also drifted 393→395 pages (new CLI subcommands from that WIP) — consistent within the gate.
